dark_pool_prints.reason: Unusual Whales free tier has some dark pool data. Large dark pool buys = institutional accumulation confirmation.

alpha101_factors.reason: WorldQuant 101 formulaic alphas — open source. 101 additional cross-sectional features, many uncorrelated with our current 260.

bid_ask_spread_trend.reason: Wider spread = illiquidity = higher expected return (Amihud 2002). Computable from yfinance options chains.
